messages:
maya (Marketing): Heads up — eu-west embeddings latency spike for ~30–45m. KV cache hits dropped, eng looking. Need marketing + statuspage copy and timing. Also: webinar at 15:00 UTC — do we hold? And SDR routing for inbound? cc @jon @kevin
jon (Growth): +1. Recommend short statuspage now, customer email in ~30m. Keep tone calm, call out scope (eu-west only). Suggest next update in 1h. :white_check_mark:
kevin (Eng): investigating. rolling restarts started 2134567950, seeing slow cache warm. suspect degraded prefix caching. mitigation ETA ~20–30m, will update. can provide short technical blurb for ops page if needed.
lisa (Support): For inbound routing — route enterprise/trial customers with active P0 tags to @sarah (Sales) via shared inbox flagged URGENT. All others to normal Support queue. I'll export affected account list in 10m.
sarah (Sales): Team on standby. pls DM the list, we'll prioritize demos/live trials first.
sam (Product): Draft wording suggestion: "We're investigating increased latency for embeddings affecting some requests in eu-west-1. There is no data loss; new requests may experience slower responses. We expect an update within one hour." Recommend drop workaround suggestions from customer copy.
maya (Marketing): Thanks — here's a tight statuspage draft, pls call edits: "We are investigating elevated latency for embeddings in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of requests. No data loss. Engineers are working on mitigation; next update ~1 hour"
jon (Growth): Social snippet for Twitter/LinkedIn: "Experiencing elevated embeddings latency in eu-west-1. We're on it — status updates: <statuspage link>. No data loss." Keep the webinar note off public social unless we postpone.
kevin (Eng): tiny technical blurb for ops doc if useful: ```Investigation: reduced KV cache hit rate due to restart cascade on embedding nodes; rolling restarts applied, warming in progress. Mitigation: restart cadence adjusted, cache load balancing to follow.```
lisa (Support): Export done — 14 accounts flagged high-priority (list shared in DM to @sarah). Also creating canned response for Support: short status link + expected ETA.
statusbot: Scheduled statuspage post at 2134567970 (in ~2m) by maya (Marketing).
maya (Marketing): Quick note on webinar at 15:00 UTC (benchmark demo): recommend HOLD and notify registrants now with tentative reschedule 1hr later. Draft line: "Session is being delayed due to a live platform issue; we expect to resume in one hour or record and distribute. We'll confirm 45 minutes before the new start." Thoughts?
sam (Product): Agree hold. Better to reschedule than start while degraded — benchmarks would mislead. Offer recording if people need immediate material.
jon (Growth): Email to registrants short template: "We're pausing today's benchmark webinar due to a platform issue; we'll send an updated start time within an hour or a recording. Apologies for the inconvenience." Keep CTA: link to statuspage + opt-in for immediate notification.
sarah (Sales): Received DM list, routing in progress. We'll ping support for any high-touch outreach.
kevin (Eng): Will post follow-up update by 2134568150 with status on cache warm and whether we rolled back any infra change. If we achieve steady state before that, we'll call it earlier.
maya (Marketing): Final checks: 1) statuspage copy approved by sam/kevin? 2) registrant email + social hold copy ready? 3) SDR routing confirmed? Please ack.
jon (Growth): ack. Social hold copy ready.
sam (Product): ack — copy ok.
kevin (Eng): ack — will update at 2134568150 or sooner.
lisa (Support): ack — SDR routing in motion. Canned support reply posted to shared doc.
maya (Marketing): I'll publish the statuspage at scheduled time and send registrant email in 10m. Thanks everyone. :pray:
statusbot: Status update posted at 2134567970: "Investigating — elevated embeddings latency in eu-west-1. Next update within 60 minutes."
maya (Marketing): Update: cache warmed, p99 latency dropping, eng monitoring. I'll post an interim update and send reschedule email to webinar registrants (propose +1h).
kevin (Eng): Confirmed — steady state but monitoring. No rollback required.
jon (Growth): Great — schedule social followup in 30m with summary and link to recording.
maya (Marketing): Closing thread — final update posted at 2134568450. Thanks team. :tada:
